name: Paneer Butter Masala
instructions: Heat butter and oil in a pan. Add finely chopped onions and saute until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and saute for a minute until the raw smell disappears.
Pour in the tomato puree, turmeric, coriander powder, red chili powder, and salt. Cook until oil starts separating from the masala.
Stir in the cashew paste and cook for another 2-3 minutes to thicken the base.
Add a little water to adjust the gravy consistency and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the paneer cubes and let them simmer for 3-5 minutes so they absorb the flavors.
Crush kasuri methi between your palms and sprinkle it into the gravy along with garam masala.
Turn off the heat, stir in the fresh cream gently, and serve hot with naan or jeera rice.
description: Paneer Butter Masala is a rich and creamy Punjabi curry made with paneer, spices, onions, tomatoes, cashews, and generous amounts of butter.
